visual_elements.description: Left plot titled 'K = 1'. Scatter of training points in three classes (red, green, blue) over a 0-2 by 0-2 feature space; horizontal axis labeled x_6 with ticks 0,1,2; vertical axis labeled x_7 with ticks 0,1,2. Decision regions are highly fragmented: blue/purple region across the top, green region on the right and lower areas, pink/red region interleaved in the lower-left; a small gray circle marker sits near (1.3, 1.6) inside the blue region.
visual_elements.position: left third of the plot row

visual_elements.description: Center plot titled 'K = 3'. Same axes (x_6 horizontal 0-2, x_7 vertical 0-2) and same red/green/blue scatter points. Decision regions are smoother than K=1: blue/purple band across the top, large green region on the right, pink/red wedge in the lower-left/center; boundaries less jagged.
visual_elements.position: middle third of the plot row

visual_elements.description: Right plot titled 'K = 31'. Same axes (x_6 horizontal 0-2, x_7 vertical 0-2) and same scatter points. Decision regions are the smoothest: blue/purple region across the top, broad pink/red horizontal band through the middle, green region at the bottom; fine local detail is washed out.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white and draw a thin dark-red (#B00020) rectangular border inset ~3% from all edges. 2. Add a light gray (#E6E6E6) horizontal band across the top ~15% of the slide. 3. Place the title 'Choice of K - Neighborhood Size' centered in that band, bold sans-serif, dark red (#B00020), large size. 4. Add a yellow (#FFF200) circle with thin dark outline at the top-right, containing '57' in dark text. 5. In the middle area, create three equal square plots side by side (left, center, right) with small gaps. 6. Each plot: x-axis labeled x_6 (subscript), ticks 0,1,2; y-axis labeled x_7 (subscript), ticks 0,1,2. 7. Caption the plots above with 'K = 1', 'K = 3', 'K = 31' respectively in small math-style text. 8. Fill each plot with three semi-transparent decision regions: pink (#F4A6A6), light green (#B7F0B1), light periwinkle (#C9C9F2); make K=1 regions highly jagged/fragmented, K=3 moderately smooth, K=31 very smooth with horizontal banding (blue top, pink middle, green bottom). 9. Overlay scatter points: red, green, and blue small dots — blue cluster along the top (x_7 ~1.7-1.9), red cluster lower-left/center, green points scattered lower area. 10. Add a small gray hollow circle marker near (1.3, 1.6) in the K=1 plot only.
